newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Iraq deputy premier to visit Moscow on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Iraq deputy premier to visit Moscow on Thursday.

text.p: Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz plans to visit Moscow on Thursday, the Iraqi Embassy said on Wednesday.
Neither the Russian Foreign Ministry nor the embassy would give details of the visit, expected to last two days.
Interfax news agency, quoting Deputy Russian Foreign Minister Viktor Posuvalyuk, said Aziz would stop in Moscow on his way from China. He would leave on Friday.
During March talks in Moscow, Aziz sought and received Russian support for the lifting of sanctions imposed by the United Nations' on Baghdad after it invaded Kuwait in 1990.

Russia has been stepping up efforts to improve ties in Asia and the Middle East, partially as a counterbalance to NATO plans to invite new members in eastern Europe. Moscow is also anxious to further cooperation with Iraq in oil development projects.
